verdicts_or_reports.element: Combat screen landing tab (header shows "DUNGEONS", "Dungeons" tab selected)

Tap Gear in the profile side list

Observe the Combat screen opens on the Dungeons tab, not Gear
Repeat steps 1-3 to reproduce

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Fletching > Plank > crafting batch dialog (same batch dialog used by Smithing/Crafting)
verdicts_or_reports.element: Experience readout under the quantity controls (\"+4200 XP total\")
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Large XP totals should be grouped with a thousands separator, e.g. "+4,200 XP total", consistent with XP elsewhere in the app ("+1,080 XP" on the Mining screen, "4,418 / 4,470 XP" on Skills).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The batch dialog's XP readout omits the thousands separator: it shows "+4200 XP total". Also reproduced with Arrow Shafts: 210 logs shows "+1050 XP total" instead of "+1,050 XP total".
steps: Open the Shop and buy 180 Logs (inventory becomes 210 Logs)
Go to Skills > Fletching
Open the Plank recipe (uses 1 Log per craft)
Leave the quantity at its Max value of 210
Observe the XP readout reading "+4200 XP total" instead of "+4,200 XP total"
Open Arrow Shafts with the same quantity to see "+1050 XP total" instead of "+1,050 XP total"

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Fletching > Plank > batch dialog (screenshot-verified; same shared batch dialog as Smithing/Crafting)
verdicts_or_reports.element: XP readout line below the quantity buttons, currently "+4200 XP total"
verdicts_or_reports.expected: XP totals of 1,000 or more should use the same grouped formatting as the rest of the app: "+4,200 XP total" (compare Mining ore rows showing "+1,080 XP", and Smithing XP "4,418 / 4,470 XP").
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The batch dialog renders the total without a thousands separator: "+4200 XP total". Reproduced on this build twice: Plank with 210 logs shows "+4200 XP total", and Arrow Shafts with 210 logs shows "+1050 XP total". Screenshot taken separately confirms the on-screen text has no comma.
steps: Open Shop and buy 180 Logs (Logs inventory becomes 210; costs 1,260 coins)
Go to Skills > Fletching
Tap the Plank row (1 Log per craft, x30 output)
The dialog opens with quantity preset to Max = 210
Read the line under the -100/-10/+10/+100 buttons: it shows "+4200 XP total"
For a second case, open Arrow Shafts (also uses 1 Log per craft) at quantity 210; it shows "+1050 XP total"

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Smithing > Bronze Bar > crafting batch dialog
verdicts_or_reports.element: XP total readout below the quantity controls ("+18 XP total")
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The total should not be truncated: the Bronze Bar recipe awards 6.2 XP per bar (the dialog itself shows "+155 XP total" for 25 bars = 25 × 6.2), so a quantity of 3 is 18.6 XP. The readout should show "+18.6 XP total" (or, if whole numbers are intended, round to "+19 XP total").
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The readout drops the fraction: quantity 3 shows "+18 XP total" (18.6 actual). Quantity 2 shows "+12 XP total" (12.4 actual) and quantity 4 shows "+24 XP total" (24.8 actual). Quantities 1/13 are also truncated (6 vs 6.2; 80 vs 80.6).
steps: Go to Skills > Smithing
Tap the Bronze Bar row to open the batch dialog
Tap the '1' quantity shortcut, then press the Increase arrow twice to set quantity to 3
Read the XP total line: it shows "+18 XP total"
Set quantity to 2 or 4 to see "+12 XP total" and "+24 XP total" (12.4 and 24.8 exact)
